description: CS5351 Group 2 D multi-source comparison. Synthetic, pre-annotated review fixtures.
snapshot_encoding: UTF-8, ordered segments joined with LF and no trailing LF
notes: Gold labels and scoring notes are only for evaluation. Never send them to retrieval, generation or baseline combination.
The harness resolves fixture IDs to content objects in an isolated store. Cue IDs and article segment IDs are fixture locators to map to native locators.
For unavailable sources, fault scheduling belongs to the evaluation harness. Never include hidden original text in a prompt after a read failure.
An accepted quote is verbatim and maps to a gold segment. It need not include the entire segment if the verified exact range supports the annotated fact.
